notes.title: RPG Maker Official VRoid Models in development! Will be available for FREE!
notes.notes:
Dear RPG Maker 3D Character Converter users, and also to those who consider purchasing!
We have further exciting news for you!

[h2][b]■RPG Maker Official VRoid Models and Parts in Production! Will be Available as Free Download![/b][/h2]

To help users create VRM models more easily, we are thrilled to also announce that we are working on producing 3.5-heads proportion model templates and custom parts for use in VRoid Studio!
You can edit these models in VRoid Studio and export as their own VRM models! You are free to use these models, so long as they are used for game-creation purposes, in any game engine!
The data will be available in a body template (known as bodysuit) and various parts and be mix-matched where necessary. 

These VRoid data will also come in VRM format as sample models!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642512/b9b26083006d37d8abe3807126629b224ce042f1.png[/img]
（You can use VRoid Studio to edit the RPG Maker Official VRoid models to make your own creations!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642512/768d89355f46597e69fbbcdf291e72f1b2409904.png[/img]
（Example usage in battle）

Below are some of the announced example screenshots and 2D sprites converted by the RPG Maker 3D Character Converter: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642512/77ce20e045f4d6babb2a7370a7def4376a2b2bac.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642512/3a801303175fb791378e7f045edeeaec0b8cee73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43642512/a5a3bc720ea17eca61aeab0c186b53ef16372ae8.png[/img]
（There has always been great demand in the RPG Maker community wanting a way to make many NPC variations quickly. As such, the official VRoid data focused on categories such as seniors, soldiers, children, and villagers.）

Please stay tuned for further information!
